title: gmlst: unified MLST, cgMLST and scheme-free bacterial typing from assemblies and reads with swappable alignment backends

creators.name: Renton, Mark
creators.affiliation: Hangzhou Center for Disease Control and Prevention, Hangzhou, China

description: gmlst unifies classical MLST, cgMLST/wgMLST and scheme-free typing in one command-line interface for assemblies and raw reads, with swappable BLAST+, KMA, minimap2 and MUMmer4 backends, unified access to PubMLST, Pasteur BIGSdb, EnteroBase and cgmlst.org schemes with API-key authentication, a two-layer exact-hash and k-mer pre-resolution, novel-allele extraction into local laboratory schemes, built-in minimum spanning trees, and an automation-first interface suited to scripts, workflow engines and autonomous agents.
